description: This file defines an abstract class CardStreamAnimator for creating various animations in a CardStreamLinearLayout, including initial, appearing, disappearing, swipe-in, and swipe-out animations, along with a simple implementation EmptyAnimator that disables animations.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator
classes.description: An abstract class which defines animators for CardStreamLinearLayout.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator.EmptyAnimator
classes.description: A static inner class providing a no-op implementation of CardStreamAnimator, effectively disabling animations.

methods.name: setSpeedFactor
methods.description: Sets the speed factor for the animations, with higher values indicating slower animations.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the initial animation when a user rotates the screen.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the animation when a view is programmatically removed.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the animation when a view is added programmatically.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the swipe-in animation when a view is not moved enough to be removed.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the swipe-out animation when a view is being removed by a user swipe.
